ja: 話題のねこぶそう、第３弾が参ります！外装パーツ４種と、このセットでないと手に入らないねこの大まんぞくセット。
• １～２弾に引き続き、ねこの原型はねこ造形作家の森口修氏が制作。
• ぶそうはイラストレーター・漫画家といて活動中の二条忠則氏が担当。
• ねこは、新規造形の長毛種ねこ。ジャケットも新規造形の洗濯カゴ型で、取っ手が可動。
• 中盛りA～Dのぶそうパーツ一式やボーナスパーツの入ったまさに「舟盛り」なセット。ぶそうパーツは舟盛り専用カラー。
• パーツを簡単に取り外せるセパレーターを同梱。
en: The third installment of the popular Nekobusou is here! A set of 4 types of exterior parts and a big cat bun that you can only get with this set.
• Continuing from the first and second editions, the cat prototype was created by cat sculptor Osamu Moriguchi.
• Busou is in charge of Tadanori Nijo, an active illustrator and manga artist.
• The cat is a long-haired cat with a new design. The jacket is also a newly designed laundry basket type, with a movable handle.
• A truly "fun-sized" set that includes a complete set of medium-sized A to D Nobuso parts and bonus parts. The Buso parts have a color exclusively for Funamori.
• Includes a separator for easy removal of parts.
